scope: Created and edited only docs/diagrams; no git state-changing commands.

types.architecture: Component map: clients, adapters, one operation layer, module ownership, Witness, kernel and deployment.
types.red-build: Sequence: transaction order and concurrent reads, then agent advice and a human decision on the same evidence. Both sequence and workflow schemas were read before selecting sequence.
types.question-lifecycle: Lifecycle v2: stored states versus raise outcomes, decision holds, new epochs, undo, timed sweep and dissolution.

verifiedAgainstCode: OPS and OP_LIST list fifteen operations; MCP_OPS is the agent subset. HTTP invokes the same registry.
reportSteps commits acceptReport before processBatchSteps. applySteps and applyBatchSteps yield after SLICE = 500.
invokeAsync queues writers at app.gate and yields to the event loop. app.reader is a query_only connection to the same casebook.db.
applySteps distinguishes exact, assumed and unresolved basis; ensureSignature normalizes failure text and applyBatchSteps groups failures by signature and scope.
runsFor includes the commit run and open planned runs accepting the target. qualifies admits slots only under their basis and method rules.
settle inserts the decision before mintWitness and applies HANDLERS with that Witness. suite.adopt, evidence.linkTest/setExcuse, runs.closeRun and policy.writePolicy are standing writers.
Agent answers under advise return advised; toItem exposes current-evidence advice without settling the question.
QuestionRow stores open, decided and dissolved. attached and carried are raise outcomes rather than extra stored states.
HoldTerm names are basis-changes, this-target, time and fact-gone. stillHolds requires every term.
undo records withdrawn with supersedes, and reopens the same question. dissolveStale handles open failure questions only in the newest run of the scope.
test/evidence.test.ts and test/runs.test.ts were read as behavioral examples. Product tests were not run by this documentation-only task.
compose.yaml defines casebook and one casebook-data volume at /data. No deferred quarantine, gap kind, attachments or PostgreSQL are depicted.

architectureDocDisagreements.topic: A decision makes the gate green only if it excuses the cause.
architectureDocDisagreements.documentQuote:
The decision changes how the run counts that cause, the verdict is
   recomputed in the same transaction, and `casebook gate` now exits 0.
architectureDocDisagreements.consequence: The red-build diagram chooses i: infra explicitly. defect, test and expected produce failed, exit 1; the diagram does not promise green for every answer.

architectureDocDisagreements.topic: An explicitly requested same-claim basis can admit another version.
architectureDocDisagreements.documentQuote:
a result fills a slot when its basis names that case at that
version
architectureDocDisagreements.consequence: The red-build card says version or claim, basis and method. Version equality is the usual path, but the code also supports same-claim.

architectureDocDisagreements.topic: An automated test is eligible through its link or annotation.
architectureDocDisagreements.documentQuote: its method is one the run asked for, and the case admits that method.
architectureDocDisagreements.consequence: An obligation still must name auto. For human and agent, the case must also declare the method. Decision 0012 already explains this departure.

extraLifecycleNuance.description: A later raise against a decided question outside its hold opens epoch + 1 with prior linked. If the periodic time sweep runs first, sweepExpired instead reopens the existing question; the expired decision remains in the ledger. Both paths are shown.
